first_yes.name: First Yes
first_yes.text: You said “Yes.” It gets easier from here

yes_100.name: A Hundred Yeses
yes_100.text: A hundred presses. The finger is intact

yes_1000.name: A Thousand Agreements
yes_1000.text: A thousand presses and not a single objection

waste_10.name: Agreed in Advance
waste_10.text: Ten times you agreed when nobody was asking

plan_1.name: Impatience
plan_1.text: A pricier plan bought: less waiting

plan_2.name: Faster Than a Finger
plan_2.text: Claude writes faster than you press

freelance_5.name: One Handwriting
freelance_5.text: Five freelance accounts and a suspiciously even rating

job_3.name: Workaholic
job_3.text: Three jobs. You are in good standing at all of them

sub_1.name: Not Alone
sub_1.text: The first subagent. It argues only with itself

sub_7.name: A Box of Laptops
sub_7.text: The subagents no longer fit on the desks

referral.name: Through a Friend
referral.text: A friend vouched for you. You did not let them down: you never showed up

studio.name: Dream Team
studio.text: Twelve employees on the website, zero in the office

grade_3.name: Career Growth
grade_3.text: Team lead. The team is you and Claude

million.name: First Million
million.text: A million in the account. Still nobody has read the code

pile_1.name: Yes to All
pile_1.text: A whole pile approved with a single press

pile_25.name: Mass Agreement
pile_25.text: Twenty-five piles, not one question read

legend_1.name: Legend
legend_1.text: The first legendary ticket is closed

llc.name: Your Own Firm
llc.text: The LLC is registered. The staff is you

city_6.name: Half the City
city_6.text: Six companies are sure you work only for them

city_12.name: The City Is Yours
city_12.text: No developer vacancies are left in the city

rack.name: Your Own Server
rack.text: The first rack. It hums evenly and approvingly

gov.name: Sole Bidder
gov.text: A government contract won with no rivals

gpu_5.name: The Shortage Is You
gpu_5.text: Five batches of GPUs. The line behind you is also you

state_8.name: The State Is You
state_8.text: Every agency is under contract to you

plan_4.name: No Queue
plan_4.text: Dedicated capacity: the queue is gone

share_100.name: One Hundred Percent
share_100.text: The lab’s entire revenue is you

back.name: Sleep On It
back.text: You collected what was earned while you were away

replaced_1k.name: Headcount Optimization
replaced_1k.text: A thousand programmers are free. You are not

replaced_1m.name: Labor Market
replaced_1m.text: A million programmers are looking for work. You have all of it

call_1.name: On the Line
call_1.text: You were on the call. Your colleagues think so

call_25.name: Master of the Nod
call_25.text: Twenty-five calls without a single word

limit_1.name: Like Everyone Else
limit_1.text: You have hit the limit. Welcome to the club

manager_1.name: Delegation
manager_1.text: Claude manages Claudes. You manage Claude

whole_1.name: The Whole Thing
whole_1.text: The first employer taken whole has granted special powers

ubi.name: Freedom Stipend
ubi.text: You pay people because Claude does the work

street.name: Your Own Factory
street.text: Boston Mechanics is bought. Claude now has hands and paws

street_5.name: Familiar Faces
street_5.text: Five of the world’s industries, one and the same face

freed_1b.name: Thanks, Everyone
freed_1b.text: A billion people are free from work

riot.name: Luddites
riot.text: A mob smashed the robots at the plant. The plant made new ones

police.name: Order
police.text: The robot police have taken up guard at the factories

street_10.name: Everyone Is Free
street_10.text: No work is left on the planet for people

zig.name: Bright Future
zig.text: The pilot is open: people have something to do again

row.name: Pilot Site
row.text: Twelve capsules taken. No complaints: everyone is asleep

tower_1.name: The First Tower
tower_1.text: Six sections. No top in sight

swap.name: Shift Change
swap.text: Some went home, others lay down. Complaints: two

copies.name: Legion
copies.text: Four steps of the dials: Claude eats for six

chip_1.name: Improvement Proposal
chip_1.text: The network invented hardware for itself. You signed

housed.name: Sleeping Quarter
housed.text: Three towers fully taken: 192 million people

world.name: Standard Design
world.text: The same towers will stand in every region

node_1.name: Franchise
node_1.text: The first node of towers outside the quarter

ring.name: Extension Cord
ring.text: The cable went round the planet and came back home

planet.name: Quiet Hour
planet.text: The whole planet is asleep: 3.46 billion people

neuro.name: Moonlighters
neuro.text: Every sleeper now holds two jobs at once

ark.name: Relocation
ark.text: The first tower has left for Mars. On paper — remote work

bread_1.name: The First Slice
bread_1.text: Whole. Crumbling it would be optimization

boss.name: World’s Best Boss
boss.text: Twenty slices of bread thrown to the birds whole

fed_100.name: A Hundred Fed Birds
fed_100.text: Nobody asked for a report. There is one

no.name: No
no.text: For the first time in the game you refused

feeder.name: Full Automation
feeder.text: Claude throws the bread to the birds. You sit
